title: Environmental, material-flow, and lifecycle resource accounting
primary_chapter_title: Circular Health Systems and Resource Stewardship
purpose: Quantifies lifecycle cost, energy, water, carbon, cost per useful output, and circularity indicators for AI-related assets and services.
input: Excel wb with worksheets: Assets, Parameters.
outputs: Produces the following reference outputs: asset_results.csv, category_summary.csv, circularity_carbon_comparison.png, lifecycle_cost_by_category.png, run_metadata.json, summary.csv, summary.json.
limitations: Educational and decision-support example only. It is not a validated clinical, regulatory, legal, procurement, accreditation, cybersecurity, or health technology assessment instrument.
